title: Hardened Release Candidate
planner: V5 (unchanged: every 0.5.0 decision and byte is preserved)

format.writer: 1.3 | 1.4 (minimal version: 1.4 only when the file contains a TS1 block)
format.compatibility_fixtures: examples/compat/ (48 files written by 0.2.1, 0.3.0, 0.4.4, 0.4.6, 0.5.0; never regenerated)

benchmark_schema: 2.2 (additive over 2.1: git revision + dirty flag, config fingerprint, threads, block size, input SHA-256)
status: implemented; release qualification (three runs on the reference machine, fuzz campaign 15 x 10 min, baseline examples/baselines/0.5.1/, tag v0.5.1) pending

golden.0.5.0: examples/golden/0.5.0/GOLDEN.json must be reproduced byte for byte (auto and ACE_SIMD=scalar)
golden.0.4.6: frozen; Corpus V3 must reproduce it

decoder_strictness: rANS final state must equal the encoder's initial state
Huffman may leave only the zero padding of its last byte
an empty output requires an empty entropy payload
primary stream of entropy-coded blocks <= 2 x block size + 1 KiB
block count <= DecodeLimits::max_block_count() in every reader
index size <= 12 + 40 x max_index_entries before allocation
